lessons.title: Linking short sentences
lessons.tip: Do not stop between sentences: the full stop, the space and the capital letter flow in the same movement.

tuto.intro: Time for speed. We chain short sentences together to work on flow from start to finish.

rules.d: Do not stop between sentences. The full stop, the space and the capital letter flow in the same movement.
Keep your eyes a step ahead of your fingers: it is the secret of fast, smooth typing.
Speed comes from suppleness, not force. Relax your shoulders and wrists.

tuto.tip: Goal: chain short sentences together with no dead time between them.

lessons.text: The sun comes up. The birds sing. The tea is ready. We go out together. Come on, quickly! Have a good day.

lessons.title: Natural medium-length sentences
lessons.tip: On a long sentence, do not freeze if you make a mistake: keep going. Type in groups of words that go together.

tuto.intro: Longer sentences, as in real life. The aim: hold your rhythm over time.

rules.d: On a long sentence, do not freeze if you make a mistake: keep going. Keeping the flow matters most.
Type in groups of words that go together, not word by word. The sentence becomes a string of small bursts.
The longer the sentence, the more a mistake costs. Aim for a speed you can hold cleanly.

tuto.tip: Goal: type a medium-length sentence in a single flow, without losing your rhythm.

lessons.text: Every morning, she opens the window and breathes the fresh air before she starts a busy day at work.

lessons.title: A full narrative paragraph
lessons.tip: A paragraph takes stamina: settle into a comfortable rhythm you can keep up to the end, without taking your eyes off the screen.

tuto.intro: A whole paragraph to type. This is about stamina: keeping your focus and steadiness to the end.

rules.d: A paragraph takes stamina. Settle into a comfortable rhythm that you can keep up without getting tired.

rules.t: Keep your eyes on the screen
rules.d: The longer the text, the stronger the temptation to look at the keyboard. Keep your eyes ahead.
Commas, full stops and apostrophes are part of the flow. Fit them in without breaking your pace.

tuto.tip: Goal: type a complete paragraph at a steady pace, from start to finish.

lessons.text: Typing without looking at your hands takes patience, but a little practice every day makes you faster and calmer. It is just a habit.

lessons.title: Professional text
lessons.tip: A professional text leaves no room for approximation: polite phrases, capital letters, careful punctuation, numbers and an address.

tuto.intro: A professional-style text: an email or letter, with an address and a number. The kind of text you will really write.

rules.d: Polite phrases, capital letters, careful punctuation: a professional text leaves no room for approximation.
Numbers, emails, @: you mix everything you have learned. It is the summary of your learning.
In a professional setting, accuracy matters as much as speed. Proofread in your head as you type.

tuto.tip: Goal: type a clean professional text, with letters, numbers and symbols mixed.

lessons.text: Dear Mrs Hall, please find our offer attached. Do not hesitate to contact us by email at info@shop.example. Kind regards, Peter Grey

lessons.title: Technical text with symbols
lessons.tip: Code and configuration: braces, quotation marks, paths and numbers. Spot the movement for each sign in advance.

tuto.intro: The full challenge: code and configuration, with braces, quotation marks, paths and numbers.

rules.d: Braces, quotation marks, colons, numbers... This text keeps Shift and the dead keys busy all the way through. It is the densest test in symbols.
Spot in advance whether the next sign is direct, needs Shift or needs a dead key. Preparation prevents getting stuck.
In code, one mistake breaks everything. Here, slow and exact beats fast and sloppy.

tuto.tip: Goal: type a technical text mixing code, symbols and numbers cleanly.

lessons.text: The file settings.json holds {"version": "1.0", "mode": "test", "port": 3000}. Run `npm start` in ~/project.

lessons.title: Speed sprint: a long text
lessons.tip: The final test: a long text to type as fast and as accurately as you can, without looking at the keyboard.

tuto.intro: The final test: a long text to type as fast and as accurately as you can. Give it everything!

rules.d: Now is the time to test your limits. Look for your top speed while staying readable.
A clean sprint beats a sprint full of mistakes. Find the point where you go fast without skidding.
If you type this text without looking at the keyboard, you have reached the goal of KeyPace. Congratulations!

tuto.tip: Goal: type a long text at your top speed, without looking at the keyboard.

lessons.text: Fast typing comes from regular practice: train a little every day, keep your eyes on the screen, and let your fingers find their place on the keyboard. Good luck!
